recipe.name: Old Town Cooler
recipe.description: A sweet, fruity cooler of fresh pineapple warmed with the house spice mix, brightened with lime and topped with soda.
steps: Muddle the pineapple chunks in a shaker until juicy.
Add the house spice mix and lime juice, then shake with ice.
Strain over fresh ice into a Collins glass and top with soda water.
recipe.ice: Shaken with ice; served over fresh ice
recipe.garnish: A pineapple wedge dusted with house spice mix
